from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs/task-437231e4.py')
source='''def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}, key=lambda c: min((r, col) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for col, v in enumerate(row) if v == c)[1])
    shapes = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, col) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for col, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
        shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
        h, w = max(r for r, c in shape)+1, max(c for r, c in shape)+1
        shapes.append((color, shape, h, w))
    out = [[0]*m for _ in range(n)]
    prev = None
    for i, (color, shape, h, w) in enumerate(shapes):
        if i == 0:
            r0 = c0 = 0
        else:
            pr, pc, ph, pw = prev
            r0, c0 = pr+ph-1, pc+pw-1
            if i == 1 and shapes[0][2] == shapes[0][3]:
                r0 += 1
        for dr, dc in shape:
            r, c = r0+dr, c0+dc
            if 0 <= r < n and 0 <= c < m:
                out[r][c] = color
        prev = (r0, c0, h, w)
    return out
'''
